body.en:
Carl Wilhelm Ottow and Johann Gottlob Geissler arrived at Mansinam near Manokwari in 1855. Their journey through the eastern Indonesian maritime network included support from the Sultan of Tidore. The mission became an important reference point in the history of Christianity in Papua.

Church accounts preserve the arrival as a founding event. Later schools and teachers connected religious work with changes in education and public life. The southern mission-school record, beginning in the early twentieth century, shows how Indigenous and other non-European teachers helped shape schooling rather than acting only as recipients of European instruction.

Catatan sekolah misi di selatan sejak awal abad ke-20 memperlihatkan bagaimana guru setempat dan guru non-Eropa lainnya ikut membentuk pendidikan.

body.en:
New Guinea lies at the northern edge of the Australian plate. Uplift and faulting formed mountain ranges that divide river basins, while coastal plains, islands and reefs support different ways of obtaining food and moving between places. Western Papua includes the western part of this island and its surrounding islands.

During the Ice Age, lower sea levels joined New Guinea, Australia and the Aru Islands into Sahul. Waigeo and other islands to the northwest remained separated by deep water. Reaching them required sea crossings. These landscapes give the settlement histories below their geographical context.
body.pmy:
Nugini berada di tepi utara lempeng Australia. Pengangkatan dan patahan membentuk pegunungan yang membagi daerah aliran sungai, sementara dataran pesisir, pulau, dan terumbu mendukung cara memperoleh pangan serta berpindah yang berbeda. Papua bagian barat mencakup bagian barat pulau ini beserta pulau-pulau sekitarnya.

Pada Zaman Es, permukaan laut yang lebih rendah menyatukan Nugini, Australia, dan Kepulauan Aru menjadi Sahul. Waigeo dan pulau lain di barat laut tetap terpisah oleh perairan dalam sehingga perlu dicapai melalui penyeberangan laut. Bentang ini menjadi konteks geografis bagi riwayat permukiman berikutnya.

note.en: Uplift formed the central mountain ranges. Lowland rivers and coastal environments support other histories on either side.
note.pmy: Pengangkatan membentuk pegunungan tengah. Sungai dataran rendah dan lingkungan pesisir menopang sejarah lain di kedua sisinya.

Mansoben’s comparative study describes regional forms of authority recorded in ethnographic research. Around Sentani, the office of ondoafi is connected to descent, kin groups and village territory. Among Mee, a tonowi builds standing through wealth, generosity and the ability to organise relationships. Maybrat bobot and Muyu kayepak also gain influence through exchange and social obligations.

Pigs, cowrie shells and kain timur circulated through relationships that connected leadership with marriage, work and reciprocity. On the western coasts, raja in Raja Ampat, Onin and Kaimana linked local authority to maritime networks and Maluku. Some offices were inherited; others depended more on achievement and support. These documented regional systems help explain the institutions and land relationships encountered by colonial administration, without assigning them a single ancient origin.
body.pmy:
Kajian perbandingan Mansoben menjelaskan bentuk kewenangan regional yang dicatat dalam penelitian etnografi. Di sekitar Sentani, kedudukan ondoafi berkaitan dengan keturunan, kelompok kekerabatan, dan wilayah kampung. Di kalangan Mee, tonowi membangun kedudukan melalui kekayaan, kemurahan hati, dan kemampuan mengatur hubungan. Bobot di Maybrat serta kayepak di Muyu juga memperoleh pengaruh melalui pertukaran dan kewajiban sosial.

Babi, kerang kauri, dan kain timur beredar melalui hubungan yang mengaitkan kepemimpinan dengan perkawinan, kerja, dan timbal balik. Di pesisir barat, raja di Raja Ampat, Onin, dan Kaimana menghubungkan kewenangan setempat dengan jaringan maritim serta Maluku. Sebagian jabatan diwariskan; yang lain lebih bergantung pada pencapaian dan dukungan. Catatan regional ini membantu menjelaskan lembaga serta hubungan tanah yang dihadapi pemerintahan kolonial, tanpa menetapkan satu masa asal bagi semuanya.

body.en:
Exchange connected communities across valleys, coasts and ecological zones. People moved shells, pigs, food and other valuables through kinship, marriage and trading relationships. These transactions could create obligations and establish a person’s standing, alongside meeting practical needs.

Mansoben describes cowrie wealth in Mee and Muyu leadership and kain timur in Maybrat social life. Access to valuables depended on wider relationships: goods arriving through coastal networks could acquire new uses and meanings inland. The systems varied by place and changed over time, but they show how authority and economic life were organised through social relationships rather than a separate administrative office.
body.pmy:
Pertukaran menghubungkan masyarakat antarlembah, pesisir, dan wilayah ekologis. Kerang, babi, pangan, serta benda berharga lain berpindah melalui kekerabatan, perkawinan, dan hubungan dagang. Transaksi dapat membentuk kewajiban serta kedudukan seseorang, sekaligus memenuhi kebutuhan sehari-hari.

Mansoben menjelaskan kekayaan kerang dalam kepemimpinan Mee dan Muyu serta kain timur dalam kehidupan sosial Maybrat. Akses pada benda berharga bergantung pada hubungan yang lebih luas: barang yang masuk melalui jaringan pesisir dapat memperoleh kegunaan serta makna baru di pedalaman. Sistem ini berbeda antardaerah dan berubah dari waktu ke waktu, tetapi memperlihatkan bagaimana kewenangan serta kehidupan ekonomi diatur melalui hubungan sosial.

body.en:
Maritime networks connected western New Guinea with Maluku over centuries. The ANU synthesis discusses tributary relations along the coasts between the fifteenth and nineteenth centuries; Overweel’s study follows the claims and negotiations described in nineteenth-century memoranda. Tidore exercised influence through coastal leaders and intermediaries rather than a uniform administration of the interior.

Trade, tribute and slave trading formed part of these encounters. Local rulers and communities negotiated relationships with competing outside powers. Dutch claims later drew on agreements with Tidore, but declaring sovereignty did not establish an administrative presence across Papua. The early Fort Du Bus settlement and the much later permanent stations illustrate that difference.
body.pmy:
Jaringan maritim menghubungkan Papua bagian barat dengan Maluku selama berabad-abad. Sintesis ANU membahas hubungan upeti di pesisir antara abad ke-15 dan ke-19; kajian Overweel menelusuri klaim serta perundingan dalam memorandum abad ke-19. Tidore menjalankan pengaruh melalui pemimpin pesisir dan perantara, bukan satu pemerintahan yang merata di pedalaman.

Perdagangan, upeti, dan perdagangan budak menjadi bagian dari perjumpaan ini. Penguasa serta masyarakat setempat berunding dengan kekuatan luar yang bersaing. Klaim Belanda kemudian bertumpu pada perjanjian dengan Tidore, tetapi pernyataan kedaulatan belum membentuk kehadiran pemerintahan di seluruh Papua. Permukiman awal Benteng Du Bus dan pos permanen yang baru berdiri jauh kemudian memperlihatkan perbedaan itu.

body.en:
Excavations at Mololo Cave on Waigeo recovered pottery dated to about 3,100–2,700 years ago, with a possible earlier occurrence around 3,800–3,500 years ago. Plain, red-slipped and incised vessels share features with ceramics elsewhere in Island Southeast Asia and the Pacific. The elaborate dentate stamping of early Lapita pottery is absent.

At Manwen Bokor Cave, later pottery from about 1,300–1,000 years ago includes more varied impressed and incised decoration. Gaffney and Tanudirjo compare these assemblages with eastern Wallacea and northern New Guinea, describing changes in the reach of regional networks. Pots and manufacturing techniques provide evidence of contact without requiring the movement of whole populations.
body.pmy:
Penggalian di Gua Mololo, Waigeo, menemukan tembikar berumur sekitar 3.100–2.700 tahun, dengan kemungkinan temuan lebih awal sekitar 3.800–3.500 tahun. Wadah polos, bersalut merah, dan bergores memiliki kesamaan dengan keramik di kawasan Asia Tenggara Kepulauan serta Pasifik. Cap bergerigi rumit yang menjadi ciri tembikar Lapita awal tidak ditemukan.

Di Gua Manwen Bokor, tembikar lebih muda dari sekitar 1.300–1.000 tahun lalu memperlihatkan hiasan tekan dan gores yang lebih beragam. Gaffney dan Tanudirjo membandingkan temuan ini dengan Wallacea timur serta Nugini utara dan menjelaskan perubahan jangkauan jaringan regional. Wadah dan teknik pembuatannya menjadi bukti hubungan tanpa harus berarti perpindahan seluruh penduduk.

Excavations at Andarewa Cave near Fakfak place its earliest recorded occupation around 26,327–25,900 years ago, during the Last Glacial Maximum. The site lies between the Bird’s Head and the wider Sahul landmass. Stone tools, bone points, shells, charcoal and ochre document activities across several occupation layers. Pottery and jewellery belong to later parts of that sequence.

Local sedimentary stone was worked into small flakes and scrapers. Imported igneous stone raises questions about movement and exchange beyond the immediate area. Together with the inland Toé Kria record, Andarewa shows that early settlement included different environments, from coastal limestone caves to rainforest in the Bird’s Head.
body.pmy:
Penggalian di Gua Andarewa dekat Fakfak menempatkan hunian paling awal yang tercatat sekitar 26.327–25.900 tahun lalu, pada puncak Zaman Es terakhir. Situs ini berada di antara Kepala Burung dan daratan Sahul yang lebih luas. Alat batu, ujung tulang, kerang, arang, serta oker mencatat kegiatan dalam beberapa lapisan hunian. Tembikar dan perhiasan berasal dari bagian yang lebih muda dalam urutan tersebut.

Batuan sedimen setempat diolah menjadi serpih kecil dan alat pengerik. Batuan beku yang didatangkan dari luar menimbulkan pertanyaan tentang perpindahan serta pertukaran melampaui lingkungan terdekat. Bersama catatan pedalaman Toé Kria, Andarewa memperlihatkan bahwa permukiman awal mencakup lingkungan yang berbeda, dari gua kapur pesisir hingga hutan Kepala Burung.

Research at Toé Kria records occupation of inland rainforest in the Bird’s Head from around 24,000 calibrated years before present. Its stone-tool and occupation sequence adds an inland perspective to early settlement evidence from coastal and island caves.

The site helps archaeologists investigate how people used rainforest environments during the late Pleistocene. Read beside Andarewa and Mololo, it documents several local histories of settlement rather than one route that explains every part of New Guinea.

Situs ini membantu arkeolog menyelidiki pemanfaatan hutan pada akhir Pleistosen. Dibaca bersama Andarewa dan Mololo, temuan tersebut mencatat beberapa riwayat permukiman setempat, bukan satu jalur yang menjelaskan seluruh Nugini.

body.en:
A worked piece of tree resin from Mololo Cave on Waigeo was radiocarbon dated to approximately 55,000–50,000 years ago. The find supplies direct evidence of plant use by people living on an island near the northwestern edge of New Guinea. Its manufacture involved collecting and processing resin rather than simply carrying an unmodified natural object into the cave.

Waigeo remained separated from Sahul by deep water even when sea levels were lower. Settlement therefore involved crossings between islands as well as movement over land. The researchers combine the cave evidence with reconstructed coastlines to examine possible journeys into the wider region; the find establishes activity at Mololo, not one definitive migration route.

Temuan ini menjadi bukti langsung pemanfaatan tumbuhan oleh orang yang hidup di pulau dekat tepi barat laut Nugini. Pembuatannya mencakup pengumpulan serta pengolahan resin, bukan sekadar membawa benda alam tanpa perubahan ke dalam gua.

Waigeo tetap terpisah dari Sahul oleh perairan dalam ketika permukaan laut lebih rendah. Permukiman dengan demikian melibatkan penyeberangan antarpulau sekaligus perpindahan darat. Peneliti memadukan bukti gua dengan rekonstruksi garis pantai untuk mengkaji kemungkinan perjalanan ke kawasan lebih luas; temuan ini menetapkan aktivitas di Mololo, bukan satu jalur migrasi yang pasti.

West New Guinea contains numerous language families and isolates alongside Austronesian languages. “Papuan” groups the non-Austronesian languages geographically; it does not name a single language family. Laura Arnold’s synthesis brings together classifications, regional distributions and evidence of contact.

The Bird’s Head includes several distinct families and isolates within a relatively small area. Elsewhere, larger proposed groupings coexist with languages whose deeper relationships remain under study. Borrowed words and grammatical features record encounters between neighbouring communities. A language map is useful for locating these relationships, but its present-day distribution cannot be read as an unchanged map of ancient peoples.

Papua bagian barat memiliki banyak rumpun bahasa serta bahasa isolat, bersama bahasa-bahasa Austronesia. Sebutan “Papua” mengelompokkan bahasa non-Austronesia secara geografis, bukan menamai satu rumpun. Sintesis Laura Arnold menghimpun klasifikasi, persebaran regional, dan bukti hubungan antarmasyarakat.

Kepala Burung memuat beberapa rumpun serta bahasa isolat dalam kawasan yang relatif kecil. Di tempat lain, pengelompokan yang lebih besar berdampingan dengan bahasa yang hubungan asalnya masih diteliti. Kata pinjaman serta unsur tata bahasa mencatat perjumpaan masyarakat bertetangga. Peta bahasa membantu menemukan hubungan tersebut, tetapi persebaran sekarang tidak dapat dibaca sebagai peta masyarakat kuno yang tidak berubah.

Malind accounts gathered in the Forest Peoples Programme’s MIFEE study describe customary land through food, work and relationships between people and places. Sago groves, gardens, hunting areas and waterways support livelihoods alongside knowledge passed through families. Decisions about land therefore affect access to existing sources of food and the ability to continue using them.

The 2013 field study records negotiations with a sugarcane company and community concerns about forest conversion. It asks whether information and consent processes enabled people to make decisions about their territories. These accounts provide an important background to later food and energy projects in Merauke: the terms of an investment agreement and the effects on everyday access to land need to be read together.
body.pmy:
Kesaksian Malind dalam kajian MIFEE Forest Peoples Programme menjelaskan tanah adat melalui pangan, kerja, serta hubungan manusia dengan tempat. Dusun sagu, kebun, wilayah berburu, dan perairan menopang penghidupan bersama pengetahuan yang diteruskan melalui keluarga. Keputusan tentang tanah dengan demikian memengaruhi akses pada sumber pangan yang sudah ada serta kemampuan untuk terus memanfaatkannya.

Kajian lapangan 2013 mencatat perundingan dengan perusahaan tebu dan kekhawatiran masyarakat tentang perubahan hutan. Kajian ini menanyakan apakah informasi serta proses persetujuan memungkinkan masyarakat mengambil keputusan atas wilayah mereka. Kesaksian tersebut menjadi latar penting bagi proyek pangan dan energi berikutnya di Merauke: ketentuan perjanjian investasi serta dampaknya pada akses tanah sehari-hari perlu dibaca bersama.

UNESCO inscribed noken-making on the List of Intangible Cultural Heritage in Need of Urgent Safeguarding in 2012. Noken are knotted or woven bags made from local fibres and used to carry food, goods and children. Making them connects plant knowledge, skilled work and everyday exchange.

The inscription identifies threats to transmission and calls for safeguarding the practice. Regional studies also show how makers negotiate changing markets and household needs. Their work continues through identifiable people and communities; contemporary works and maker photographs can be explored in Exhibition.

text.en: The Dutch established Fort Du Bus on the southwest coast in 1828 and proclaimed a territorial claim over western New Guinea. The settlement was short-lived. A declaration and a coastal fort did not establish effective control over the island’s many communities.

text.en: Kamoro objects entered European museums through encounters with traders, expeditions, colonial officers, missionaries and anthropologists. Karen Jacobs traces acquisitions from the Triton expedition in 1828 to collections made during the Kamoro Arts Festival between 1998 and 2006. An armlet collected in 1828 illuminates exchange practices connected to eastern Indonesian trade recorded from the seventeenth century.

Karen Jacobs menelusuri perolehan sejak ekspedisi Triton pada 1828 hingga koleksi dari Festival Seni Kamoro pada 1998–2006. Gelang lengan yang dikoleksi pada 1828 menerangkan praktik pertukaran terkait perdagangan dengan Indonesia timur yang tercatat sejak abad ketujuh belas.

text.en: Museum holdings preserve an uneven record: this study finds relatively little material from the late 1960s to the 1990s. Collectors’ interests shaped what was kept. text.en: A Dutch administrative station was established at Merauke in 1902. Expansion in the south involved policing, mission activity and intervention in local settlements and movement. The colonial record describes these measures through the government’s own objectives.

text.en: Research on missions and schools shows that administration did not advance through European officials alone. Non-European teachers and local relationships were central to the process. text.en: Japanese occupation and Allied campaigns transformed parts of New Guinea into military landscapes. Biak and Hollandia were major sites in the 1944 campaigns. Airfields, wrecks and other material remains continue to mark places where Papuan communities lived through occupation, labour demands and fighting.
text.pmy: Pendudukan Jepang dan operasi Sekutu mengubah sebagian Nugini menjadi bentang militer. Biak dan Hollandia menjadi lokasi utama operasi 1944. Lapangan terbang, bangkai peralatan, dan sisa lain masih menandai tempat masyarakat Papua mengalami pendudukan, tuntutan tenaga kerja, dan pertempuran.

text.en: Military archives often focus on operations and equipment. Archaeological work on Biak adds another route into the record, while local memory can describe experiences left out of official accounts. A wartime photograph documents a particular scene; it does not by itself explain the civilian experience around it.

Foto perang merekam adegan tertentu; foto itu sendiri tidak menjelaskan seluruh pengalaman warga sipil di sekitarnya.

text.en: Among Mee communities in the central ranges, cowrie shells known as meege are used in marriage payments. Martinus Tekege’s account describes a payment from the groom’s side to the bride’s family as part of customary recognition of a marriage. The shells also express a relationship between families, with obligations that extend beyond the wedding itself.
text.pmy: Di masyarakat Mee di pegunungan tengah, cangkang kerang yang disebut meege digunakan dalam pembayaran perkawinan. Martinus Tekege menjelaskan pembayaran dari pihak laki-laki kepada keluarga perempuan sebagai bagian pengakuan perkawinan secara adat. Kerang juga menyatakan hubungan antarkeluarga, dengan kewajiban yang melampaui hari perkawinan.

text.en: Tekege writes from personal experience and Mee perspectives. He records debate about the practice’s continuing relevance, including concerns about gender and changing economic circumstances. text.en: Indonesia and the Netherlands signed the New York Agreement on 15 August 1962. It arranged a temporary United Nations administration before the transfer to Indonesia on 1 May 1963. It also provided for an act of self-determination before the end of 1969. Papuan representatives were not signatories. For many independence advocates, this exclusion is central: decisions about the territory’s future were negotiated by others, while the promised opportunity to choose remained ahead.

text.en: Pepera, the Act of Free Choice, was conducted in 1969 through representative assemblies rather than a vote of all adult inhabitants. Indonesian authorities selected 1,026 representatives, who supported integration. text.en: The 1949 transfer of Dutch sovereignty to Indonesia left West New Guinea under Dutch administration. Indonesia claimed it as part of the former Netherlands East Indies; Dutch policy increasingly pursued a separate political future. The unresolved territory became a diplomatic dispute, but political organising within Papua also took several directions.
text.pmy: Penyerahan kedaulatan Belanda kepada Indonesia pada 1949 meninggalkan Nugini Barat di bawah pemerintahan Belanda. Indonesia mengklaimnya sebagai bagian bekas Hindia Belanda; kebijakan Belanda makin mengarah pada masa depan politik yang terpisah. Wilayah yang belum disepakati ini menjadi sengketa diplomatik, sementara organisasi politik di Papua berkembang dalam beberapa arah.

text.en: In Serui, Silas Papare’s organising connected Papua with the Indonesian republic. Johan Ariks and other leaders advocated a distinct Papuan future. Chauvel’s regional study follows these different positions through Serui, Biak, Hollandia and Fakfak, where local networks, education and relations with officials shaped political choices.

Indonesia claimed it as part of the former Netherlands East Indies; Dutch policy increasingly pursued a separate political future. The unresolved territory became a diplomatic dispute, but political organising within Papua also took several directions.

sources.title: Constructing Papuan Nationalism: History, Ethnicity, and Adaptation

text.en: The New Guinea Council opened in Hollandia on 5 April 1961. Its elected and appointed members debated government and the territory’s future while Indonesia demanded a transfer and the Netherlands proposed preparations for self-determination. The Council gave Papuan representatives an institutional platform, within a colonial administration that still controlled the timetable.
text.pmy: Dewan Nugini dibuka di Hollandia pada 5 April 1961. Anggota yang dipilih dan ditunjuk membahas pemerintahan serta masa depan wilayah ketika Indonesia menuntut penyerahan dan Belanda mengusulkan persiapan penentuan nasib sendiri. Dewan memberi wakil Papua ruang kelembagaan, dalam pemerintahan kolonial yang masih mengendalikan jadwalnya.

text.en: On 19 October, a meeting in Hollandia established a Papuan National Committee and issued a political manifesto. It called for the name West Papua, the Morning Star flag and the anthem Hai Tanahku Papua. Nicolaas Jouwe, E.J. Bonay, Nicolaas Tanggahma and F. Torey were among the political figures seeking a Papuan voice in the negotiations.
text.pmy: Pada 19 Oktober, pertemuan di Hollandia membentuk Komite Nasional Papua dan mengeluarkan Manifest Politik. Dokumen ini meminta penggunaan nama Papua Barat, bendera Bintang Kejora, dan lagu Hai Tanahku Papua. Nicolaas Jouwe, E.J. Bonay, Nicolaas Tanggahma, dan F. Torey termasuk tokoh yang mengupayakan keterlibatan Papua dalam perundingan.

text.en: The representatives differed over the next step. Some wanted an immediate declaration of independence; others favoured introducing national symbols before a transfer of sovereignty. The Morning Star was raised alongside the Dutch flag on 1 December, while colonial government continued. These debates document Papuan political initiatives that cannot be reduced to the competing Dutch and Indonesian positions.
text.pmy: Para wakil berbeda pendapat tentang langkah selanjutnya. Sebagian menginginkan pernyataan kemerdekaan segera; yang lain mendukung penggunaan simbol nasional sebelum penyerahan kedaulatan. Bintang Kejora dikibarkan bersama bendera Belanda pada 1 Desember, sementara pemerintahan kolonial tetap berjalan. Perdebatan ini mencatat prakarsa politik Papua di tengah persaingan kepentingan Belanda dan Indonesia.

text.en: Mining, plantations and migration changed livelihoods and control over land. An economic project could be described by government or business as development while the people living there experienced loss of forests, food sources or decision-making power. Research by AJAR and the Papuan Women’s Working Group begins with these lived relationships. Its case studies ask what land means to women and how they respond when forests become concessions.

Penelitian AJAR dan Kelompok Kerja Perempuan Papua bertolak dari hubungan yang dialami sehari-hari. Studi kasusnya membahas arti tanah bagi perempuan dan tanggapan mereka ketika hutan menjadi konsesi.

body.en:
The Asian Human Rights Commission’s investigation reconstructs military violence in the Central Highlands during 1977–1978 through survivor interviews and named-victim records. It describes attacks, deaths and displacement across communities rather than one isolated confrontation. Survivors’ accounts connect the violence with damage to homes, food supplies and livelihoods.

The reconstruction is a later human-rights investigation, with estimates tied to its stated method and sources. Community testimony remains central to understanding how these operations shaped relations with state institutions and the difficulties of return.

Kesaksian penyintas menghubungkan kekerasan dengan kerusakan rumah, persediaan pangan, dan penghidupan.

text.en: West Papuan delegates meeting in Vanuatu agreed on the Saralana Declaration in December 2014 and formed the United Liberation Movement for West Papua, ULMWP. Its founding umbrella brought together the National Federal Republic of West Papua, the West Papua National Coalition for Liberation and the National Parliament of West Papua.
text.pmy: Delegasi Papua Barat yang bertemu di Vanuatu menyepakati Deklarasi Saralana pada Desember 2014 dan membentuk United Liberation Movement for West Papua, ULMWP. Organisasi payung ini mempertemukan Negara Federal Republik Papua Barat, West Papua National Coalition for Liberation, dan Parlemen Nasional West Papua.

text.en: The agreement sought a common diplomatic vehicle for movements that had often competed over leadership and representation. IPAC’s 2015 assessment describes the organisational backgrounds and limits of that unity. A shared diplomatic body did not mean that all domestic organisers or armed commanders followed one leadership.
text.pmy: Kesepakatan ini mengupayakan wadah diplomatik bersama bagi gerakan yang kerap bersaing dalam kepemimpinan dan keterwakilan. Penilaian IPAC pada 2015 menguraikan latar organisasi serta batas persatuan tersebut. Badan diplomatik bersama tidak berarti seluruh penggerak di dalam negeri atau komandan bersenjata mengikuti satu kepemimpinan.

text.en: ULMWP’s institutional history later records a provisional government initiative in 2020. That is the movement’s own description of its political project. body.en:
Racist abuse against Papuan students in Surabaya helped trigger protests across Papua in August 2019. Demonstrators connected discrimination with demands over rights and political treatment. Responses included arrests and restrictions on information, while events differed between locations.

Human Rights Watch’s investigation follows those experiences through interviews and case research. It documents discrimination affecting students and other Papuans beyond the demonstrations, placing the protests within a longer pattern of unequal treatment.

Tanggapan mencakup penangkapan serta pembatasan informasi, dengan kejadian yang berbeda di tiap tempat.

Penyelidikan Human Rights Watch menelusuri pengalaman tersebut melalui wawancara dan kajian kasus. Laporan mendokumentasikan diskriminasi yang dialami mahasiswa dan warga Papua di luar demonstrasi, menempatkan protes dalam pola perlakuan tidak setara yang lebih panjang.

On 3 June 2020, the Jakarta State Administrative Court ruled that the government’s internet throttling and shutdown in Papua and West Papua during the 2019 protests were unlawful. AJI and SAFEnet brought the case against the communications minister and president.

The interruption had affected journalism, organising and access to information. The ruling established a legal finding about those government actions, giving later debates over internet restrictions a concrete precedent.

Gangguan tersebut berdampak pada jurnalisme, pengorganisasian, dan akses informasi. Putusan menetapkan temuan hukum atas tindakan pemerintah itu dan menjadi rujukan nyata bagi perdebatan pembatasan internet berikutnya.

text.en: Humanitarian access remains a central issue in the recent record. UN experts called for urgent access in 2022, while the Human Rights Committee’s 2024 dialogue put questions about Papua to the Indonesian government. Human Rights Watch’s May 2025 investigation describes renewed fighting and displacement in several highland regencies.
text.pmy: Akses kemanusiaan tetap menjadi persoalan utama dalam catatan terkini. Pakar PBB meminta akses mendesak pada 2022, sementara dialog Komite HAM pada 2024 mengajukan pertanyaan tentang Papua kepada pemerintah Indonesia. Penyelidikan Human Rights Watch pada Mei 2025 membahas pertempuran serta pengungsian di sejumlah kabupaten pegunungan.

text.en: Churches serve as places of refuge, and pastors, health workers and local journalists help document what happens in areas difficult to reach. Their accounts connect security operations with the practical conditions of food, shelter and care. Claims about the number of displaced people need to be read with the reporting date, area covered and access available to the investigator.
text.pmy: Gereja menjadi tempat perlindungan, sementara pendeta, tenaga kesehatan, dan jurnalis setempat membantu mendokumentasikan kejadian di wilayah yang sulit dijangkau. Catatan mereka menghubungkan operasi keamanan dengan keadaan pangan, tempat tinggal, dan perawatan. Angka pengungsi perlu dibaca bersama tanggal pelaporan, wilayah yang dicakup, serta akses yang dimiliki peneliti.

text.en: The release of New Zealand pilot Phillip Mehrtens in September 2024, after captivity beginning in February 2023, also illustrates the role of particular armed commanders and negotiations. The hostage-taking and its resolution are not interchangeable with the wider history of civilian displacement, but both affect movement and access to services in conflict areas.

Penyanderaan dan penyelesaiannya berbeda dari sejarah pengungsian warga secara luas, tetapi keduanya memengaruhi pergerakan serta akses layanan di wilayah konflik.

The camp was remote from the colonial centres on Java, but situated within an inhabited southern Papuan landscape, along the Digul River.

The camp photograph in this account records its built environment, rather than the whole experience of people living around it.

text.en: Resistance to Indonesian rule developed after the administrative transfer of 1963. Accounts trace armed rebellion in Manokwari in 1965 and the emergence of the Organisasi Papua Merdeka, or OPM. The name came to cover local armed commands, political organisers and supporters with different histories and strategies.

Catatan menelusuri pemberontakan bersenjata di Manokwari pada 1965 dan kemunculan Organisasi Papua Merdeka, atau OPM. Nama ini kemudian mencakup komando bersenjata setempat, penggerak politik, dan pendukung dengan riwayat serta strategi yang berbeda.

text.en: In 1971, Seth Rumkorem and Jacob Prai proclaimed a Republic of West Papua. Subsequent disputes produced competing command networks, including the MARVIC and Pemka groupings. Perpecahan ini memengaruhi hubungan antara pemimpin pesisir, komando pegunungan, dan wakil di luar negeri; struktur komandonya tidak selalu menyatu.

Organisation names and alliances have changed across time.

sources.title: The Integration of Refugees into a Host Country
Dwelling in Exile

text.en: In 1984, unrest and military operations were followed by a large movement of Papuans into Papua New Guinea. Rosemary Preston’s study examines refugees’ experience from 1984 to 1986, including the difficult relationship between humanitarian assistance, border policy and political aspirations.
text.pmy: Pada 1984, pergolakan dan operasi militer diikuti perpindahan besar orang Papua ke Papua Nugini. Kajian Rosemary Preston membahas pengalaman pengungsi pada 1984–1986, termasuk hubungan yang sulit antara bantuan kemanusiaan, kebijakan perbatasan, dan aspirasi politik.

text.en: People who crossed included families, political activists and people from communities with kinship ties across the border. Camps and settlements became sites of both everyday survival and organising. Later ethnographic work by Diana Glazebrook follows how refugees negotiated exile, education, subsistence and movement between settlement and border communities.
text.pmy: Mereka yang menyeberang mencakup keluarga, aktivis politik, dan warga dari masyarakat yang memiliki hubungan kerabat lintas batas. Kamp dan permukiman menjadi tempat menjalani kehidupan sehari-hari sekaligus berorganisasi. Penelitian etnografi Diana Glazebrook kemudian mengikuti cara pengungsi menjalani pengasingan, pendidikan, penghidupan, dan perpindahan antara permukiman serta masyarakat perbatasan.

text.en: Mama Yosepha Alomang organised Amungme resistance to the environmental and social effects of Freeport’s mining operations. Her work joined land claims with women’s livelihoods, collective action and the treatment of Indigenous people around the mine. The Goldman Environmental Prize recognised her work in 2001.

sources.publisher: Jim Elmslie, Camellia Webb-Gannon & Peter King · 2011

text.en: The West Papua National Committee, KNPB, emerged in 2008 as a domestic mobilising organisation advocating a referendum. IPAC’s later account follows its relationship with the National Parliament of West Papua, PNWP, and distinguishes these political networks from armed commands and representatives based abroad.
text.pmy: Komite Nasional Papua Barat, KNPB, muncul pada 2008 sebagai organisasi mobilisasi di dalam negeri yang memperjuangkan referendum. Kajian IPAC kemudian mengikuti hubungannya dengan Parlemen Nasional West Papua, PNWP, serta membedakan jaringan politik ini dari komando bersenjata dan wakil yang berbasis di luar negeri.

text.en: At the same time, Neles Tebay and Muridan Widjojo worked through the Papua Peace Network to prepare dialogue between Jakarta and Papua. In a 2010 interview, Tebay described nine local consultations and the need to involve communities, different organisations and the diaspora. Representation, mistrust and an agreed agenda were practical obstacles, rather than matters resolved by announcing dialogue.
text.pmy: Pada waktu yang sama, Neles Tebay dan Muridan Widjojo bekerja melalui Jaringan Damai Papua untuk menyiapkan dialog Jakarta–Papua. Dalam wawancara 2010, Tebay menjelaskan sembilan konsultasi setempat dan kebutuhan melibatkan masyarakat, berbagai organisasi, serta diaspora. Keterwakilan, ketidakpercayaan, dan agenda yang disepakati menjadi hambatan nyata yang perlu dikerjakan.

text.en: The 2011 report Anatomy of an Occupation analysed leaked Indonesian military documents mapping armed groups, political organisers and civilian networks. Its authors argue that this surveillance treated a broad range of Papuan civic activity as a security concern. The report is evidence about military classification and monitoring; its lists do not establish that every named civilian belonged to an armed organisation.
text.pmy: Laporan Anatomy of an Occupation pada 2011 menganalisis dokumen militer Indonesia yang bocor, berisi pemetaan kelompok bersenjata, penggerak politik, dan jaringan sipil. Penulisnya menilai pengawasan ini memperlakukan beragam kegiatan masyarakat Papua sebagai persoalan keamanan. Laporan tersebut menjadi sumber tentang klasifikasi dan pemantauan militer; daftarnya tidak membuktikan bahwa setiap warga yang disebut merupakan anggota organisasi bersenjata.

text.en: Amungme plaintiffs brought claims against Freeport in Jakarta in 2009 and again in March 2010. Contemporaneous reporting describes demands for compensation over customary land and the impacts of mining. The reported figures were amounts sought by plaintiffs, not damages awarded by a court.
text.pmy: Penggugat Amungme mengajukan tuntutan terhadap Freeport di Jakarta pada 2009 dan kembali pada Maret 2010. Pelaporan saat itu membahas permintaan ganti rugi atas tanah adat serta dampak pertambangan. Angka yang diberitakan merupakan tuntutan penggugat, bukan ganti rugi yang telah diputuskan pengadilan.

text.en: BBC’s report of 9 March 2010 identifies lawyer Johnson Panjaitan and a filing at the South Jakarta District Court the previous day. It also reports Freeport’s written response that earlier cases had been dismissed. sources.title: TPNPB allegedly attacks health center in Kiwirok, murders a nurse
Destroy them first… discuss human rights later: Kiwirok investigation
UN experts call for urgent humanitarian access in Papua
Ketika pejuang kesehatan korban aksi KKB diselamatkan

text.en: On 13 September 2021, an armed attack in Kiwirok destroyed public facilities including the health centre. Jubi reported an alleged TPNPB attack and the death of nurse Gabriella Meliani. Reports identify the armed group associated with Lamek Taplo; health workers were evacuated and residents lost access to local services. TPNPB spokesman Sebby Sambom denied that the group killed the nurse and called for a UN investigation.
text.pmy: Pada 13 September 2021, serangan bersenjata di Kiwirok menghancurkan fasilitas umum termasuk puskesmas. Jubi melaporkan dugaan serangan TPNPB dan kematian perawat Gabriella Meliani. Pelaporan menyebut kelompok bersenjata yang dikaitkan dengan Lamek Taplo; tenaga kesehatan dievakuasi dan warga kehilangan akses layanan setempat. Juru bicara TPNPB Sebby Sambom membantah kelompoknya membunuh perawat tersebut dan meminta penyelidikan PBB.

text.en: Human Rights Monitor’s 2023 investigation documents subsequent Indonesian military attacks on villages, using witness interviews and satellite-image analysis. It reports destroyed buildings and displacement into forests. These are the investigation’s findings about operations and civilian harm, separate from its legal assessment of possible crimes against humanity.
text.pmy: Penyelidikan Human Rights Monitor pada 2023 mendokumentasikan serangan militer Indonesia berikutnya terhadap kampung, melalui wawancara saksi dan analisis citra satelit. Laporan mencatat bangunan yang hancur serta pengungsian ke hutan. Temuan tentang operasi dan dampak pada warga ini dibedakan dari penilaian hukumnya mengenai kemungkinan kejahatan terhadap kemanusiaan.

text.en: Displacement interrupted food production, schooling and medical care. The loss of a health centre, the evacuation of staff and the difficulty of reaching people in shelters show how conflict affects care beyond the immediate attack. UN experts called for urgent humanitarian access in March 2022, including assistance to people displaced by violence.
text.pmy: Pengungsian mengganggu produksi pangan, sekolah, dan perawatan kesehatan. Hilangnya puskesmas, evakuasi petugas, serta sulitnya menjangkau warga di tempat perlindungan memperlihatkan dampak konflik pada layanan di luar serangan langsung. Pakar PBB meminta akses kemanusiaan mendesak pada Maret 2022, termasuk bantuan bagi warga yang mengungsi akibat kekerasan.

sources.title: Renewed Fighting Threatens West Papua Civilians

text.en: Paradise Bombed, a 2023 investigation by Australian journalist Kristo Langker, and Paradise Broadcasting’s 2025 film Frontier War draw attention to aerial attacks in the Papuan highlands. Human Rights Monitor’s Kiwirok report provides a separate record of military raids, displacement and damage to settlements.
text.pmy: Paradise Bombed, penyelidikan 2023 oleh jurnalis Australia Kristo Langker, dan film Frontier War dari Paradise Broadcasting pada 2025 menyoroti serangan udara di pegunungan Papua. Laporan Kiwirok dari Human Rights Monitor menyediakan catatan terpisah tentang operasi militer, pengungsian, dan kerusakan permukiman.

text.en: Frontier War prompted allegations about white phosphorus and calls for an international inquiry. Earlier allegations concerning Nduga in 2018 were denied by the Indonesian military. A UK parliamentary answer in February 2025 said its government had found no compelling evidence that white phosphorus had been used illegally in the earlier allegations; it did not establish the identity of every munition shown in the later film.
text.pmy: Frontier War memicu tuduhan penggunaan fosfor putih dan seruan penyelidikan internasional. Tuduhan sebelumnya terkait Nduga pada 2018 dibantah militer Indonesia. Jawaban parlemen Inggris pada Februari 2025 menyatakan pemerintahnya tidak menemukan bukti kuat penggunaan fosfor putih secara melanggar hukum dalam tuduhan sebelumnya; jawaban itu tidak menetapkan jenis setiap amunisi dalam film yang lebih baru.

text.en: Human Rights Watch’s May 2025 reporting describes accounts from pastors, church workers and local journalists of drones and helicopter gunships dropping bombs. It notes the difficulty of corroborating abuses in remote conflict areas. Civilian harm, the weapon used and a legal finding are distinct questions: the available investigations support further scrutiny without settling every weapons claim.
text.pmy: Pelaporan Human Rights Watch pada Mei 2025 memuat keterangan pendeta, pekerja gereja, dan jurnalis lokal mengenai drone serta helikopter tempur yang menjatuhkan bom. Laporan mencatat sulitnya memeriksa pelanggaran di wilayah konflik terpencil. Dampak pada warga, jenis senjata, dan temuan hukum merupakan pertanyaan yang berbeda; penyelidikan yang tersedia mendukung pemeriksaan lebih lanjut tanpa menyelesaikan setiap klaim senjata.

text.en: New Guinea’s food histories include the cultivation of plants alongside hunting, fishing and gathering. The archaeological record at Kuk, in present-day Papua New Guinea, documents changes in wetland cultivation and drainage over several millennia. It is important island-wide context, rather than a timetable for every part of western Papua.
text.pmy: Sejarah pangan Nugini mencakup budidaya tumbuhan bersama berburu, menangkap ikan, dan meramu. Rekaman arkeologi Kuk, di wilayah Papua Nugini sekarang, menunjukkan perubahan budidaya lahan basah dan drainase selama beberapa milenium. Kuk memberi konteks sejarah pulau, bukan jadwal perkembangan bagi seluruh Papua bagian barat.

text.en: The western region needs its own evidence from excavated sites, plant remains and environmental records. Sago forests, gardens and exchanges between ecological zones also matter; agricultural history cannot be reduced to the arrival of a single crop or an outside farming population.

sources.title: Pergerakan Ekumene GKI di Tanah Papua, 1962–2020
Zakheus Pakage and His Communities
Interview with Neles Tebay

text.en: GKI di Tanah Papua became an independent church in 1956, after the long history of Protestant missions that began at Mansinam. Its synod and congregations developed a Papuan institutional network linking education, pastoral work and public affairs. A historical study published by STFT GKI I.S. Kijne examines its ecumenical work for justice and peace between 1962 and 2020.
text.pmy: GKI di Tanah Papua berdiri sebagai gereja mandiri pada 1956, setelah riwayat panjang misi Protestan yang bermula di Mansinam. Sinode dan jemaatnya membentuk jaringan kelembagaan Papua yang menghubungkan pendidikan, pelayanan, serta kehidupan publik. Kajian sejarah yang diterbitkan STFT GKI I.S. Kijne membahas karya ekumenisnya untuk keadilan dan perdamaian pada 1962–2020.

text.en: In the western highlands, Zakheus Pakage’s community shows another route into Christian life and Indigenous leadership. Benny Giay’s study follows how Mee religious discourse, social resistance and historical change were connected. This history helps explain the later public role of Kingmi leaders without treating Papuan congregations as passive recipients of missionary institutions.
text.pmy: Di pegunungan barat, komunitas Zakheus Pakage memperlihatkan jalur lain dalam kehidupan Kristen dan kepemimpinan masyarakat adat. Kajian Benny Giay mengikuti hubungan wacana keagamaan Mee, perlawanan sosial, serta perubahan sejarah. Riwayat ini membantu menjelaskan peran publik pemimpin Kingmi berikutnya melalui prakarsa jemaat Papua sendiri.

text.en: GKI, Kingmi and Catholic institutions have distinct histories and positions. Churches later hosted consultations, provided places of refuge and documented violence, while leaders such as Neles Tebay helped prepare dialogue. Their public role developed through these institutions and local relationships, rather than one uniform political position shared by all churches.
text.pmy: GKI, Kingmi, dan lembaga Katolik memiliki riwayat serta sikap yang berbeda. Gereja kemudian menjadi tempat konsultasi, menyediakan perlindungan, dan mendokumentasikan kekerasan, sementara tokoh seperti Neles Tebay membantu menyiapkan dialog. Peran publik tersebut berkembang melalui lembaga dan hubungan setempat, dengan sikap politik yang beragam.

sources.title: Kobe Oser freedom march in The Hague
Kobe Oser Koerier

text.en: Kobe Oser appears in a Dutch diplomatic record dated 6 February 1962 as a Papuan student association. The record describes a meeting initiated by the association with representatives of mission and church organisations. It places student organising alongside the political negotiations over West New Guinea, rather than beginning the diaspora’s history with the later ULMWP.
text.pmy: Kobe Oser tercatat dalam dokumen diplomatik Belanda bertanggal 6 Februari 1962 sebagai perkumpulan mahasiswa Papua. Dokumen menguraikan pertemuan yang diprakarsai perkumpulan tersebut bersama wakil organisasi misi dan gereja. Catatan ini menempatkan kegiatan mahasiswa di tengah perundingan Nugini Barat, jauh sebelum pembentukan ULMWP.

text.en: A Nationaal Archief photograph dated 9 May 1969 documents Kobe Oser members and supporters marching in The Hague and submitting petitions to the Dutch parliament and the US and Indonesian embassies. The catalogue describes it as the closing stage of a West Papua freedom march. PACE also preserves a catalogue entry for the association’s Kobe Oser Koerier periodical.
text.pmy: Foto Nationaal Archief bertanggal 9 Mei 1969 mendokumentasikan anggota Kobe Oser serta pendukung yang berbaris di Den Haag dan menyampaikan petisi kepada parlemen Belanda serta kedutaan Amerika Serikat dan Indonesia. Katalog menyebutnya sebagai penutup suatu pawai kebebasan Papua Barat. PACE juga menyimpan entri katalog terbitan Kobe Oser Koerier dari perkumpulan ini.

text.en: Komnas HAM investigated violence in Wasior in 2001 and Wamena in 2003 as cases of alleged gross human-rights violations. These investigations concern particular operations and victims, distinct from the political killing of Theys Eluay and the later Paniai case.

text.en: VOA’s 2016 reporting follows the commission’s opposition to resolving the cases solely through a political approach. A finding by investigators, a government acknowledgement and a court judgment each have different legal consequences.

LPMAK Sustainability Report 2019

text.en: Rumah Sakit Mitra Masyarakat in Timika developed through cooperation between Freeport Indonesia, the local community development institution, the Mimika government and the Catholic diocese. Its institutional history places medical services within the changing mining region, where communities also organised over land and environmental harm.
text.pmy: Rumah Sakit Mitra Masyarakat di Timika berkembang melalui kerja sama Freeport Indonesia, lembaga pengembangan masyarakat setempat, pemerintah Mimika, dan keuskupan Katolik. Riwayat kelembagaannya menempatkan layanan medis dalam kawasan pertambangan yang berubah, sementara masyarakat juga berorganisasi mengenai tanah serta kerusakan lingkungan.

text.en: The hospital’s public history and the LPMAK sustainability report document the role of community development funding and service institutions. LPMAK’s transition to YPMAK in 2019 changed the organisational arrangement. These records help trace access to care and institutional responsibilities; they do not by themselves establish that environmental claims against mining were resolved.
text.pmy: Riwayat publik rumah sakit serta laporan keberlanjutan LPMAK mencatat peran dana pengembangan masyarakat dan lembaga layanan. Peralihan LPMAK menjadi YPMAK pada 2019 mengubah pengaturan organisasinya. Catatan ini membantu menelusuri akses perawatan dan tanggung jawab lembaga; keberadaan layanan tersebut tidak dengan sendirinya menyelesaikan tuntutan lingkungan terhadap pertambangan.
